_notes.port: 5556 rather than the GR00T default 5555, so an RLDX-1 run can sit alongside a GR00T server without a port clash.
_notes.embodiment_tag: RLDX-1 ships no general_embodiment entry in MODALITY_CONFIGS, so modality_config_path is mandatory, not optional.
_notes.video: Single frame (RLDX-1-PT-IMG, video_length 1, delta_indices [0]) to stay symmetric with the single-frame GR00T baselines. The adapter therefore needs no frame buffer.
_notes.session_id: Omitted on purpose: the memory module is disabled for can-sorting, so no session bookkeeping is sent.
